description: This file defines a React functional component named 'GraphD3' that renders a force-directed adjacency graph of roles using D3.js. It includes props for configuration, handles dynamic data, deterministic initial node placement based on a hash, and visualizes role relationships with color coding based on readiness analysis.

methods.name: colorForReadiness
methods.description: Returns a color based on the ReadinessBand ('ready', 'near', 'far') for node coloring.

methods.name: outlineForNode
methods.description: Provides stroke outline color for nodes, highlighting the target role.

methods.name: LegendItem
methods.description: A React component for rendering legend items indicating readiness states.
